Prior repository/workflow recovery established that the exact old 335-player PR147 Year-1 vector is not durably stored in repository/workflow artifacts; only named values, hashes, and partial rows survive there.
Therefore the exact preserved production baseline record cannot be decoded, its invalidation state cannot be proven, and the required 335-player board cannot be materialized from the exact artifact.

This means fresh live full-season evidence can still be preferred over the preserved preseason baseline for the frozen Year-1 Intrinsic coordinate.
